about: B-18eb: the 2.369.410 push's mirror run 44368748819, attempt 2 a re-run of its failed jobs (heavy 3/7 and the heavy gate). Read by hand at the push and trimmed: each job's id, name, attempt, status, conclusion, start and end (the suite builds check_run_url from the id: an Actions job IS its check run). annotations: by check-run id — attempt 1's six shards that attempt 2 copied, attempt 2's re-run of heavy 3/7, and the copy of heavy 4/7 in attempt 2 as read (none); the other copies were not read and count as the same. The heavy 3/7 read names no check run; both of its attempts' logs print the same «(0):» line, so it is kept under the re-run.
